decision.name: READER_VISIBILITY_MANDATORY_SEPARATE_FROM_WRITER_FINAL_STATE
decision.reason: Pinned two-writer P0 checks final three files only. Even a correct writer-serialization repair can still expose [new,old,old] to a concurrent reader between individually atomic replacements. Prior pinned Oct14 reader-interleave oracle covers this separate property but has never run as exact-repo pytest. Make it an explicit independent A acceptance gate: a consumer-facing read must return one generation or detect/retry incomplete publication; do not infer reader atomicity from a P0 writer-only GREEN. Preserve existing P0/P1 contracts; no new speculative test code.
no_network_contract: Pin exact checkout SHA and source blob IDs; run python -m pytest -q part2/capital_flow/tests -rs as baseline.
Apply only pinned test-only P0 writer, Oct14 reader-interleave, and P1 POSIX process matrix overlays to disposable checkout; never commit Specialist code.

Run targeted P0 writer and P1 process pytest; for reader gate seed G0, pause G1 immediately after latest.json replacement, read via documented consumer-facing snapshot protocol, require coherent generation or explicit fail-closed retry; capture pause/reader stamps and writer exits.
Run python -m pytest -q part2/capital_flow/tests -rs with overlays; preserve stdout/stderr, exit codes, non-skip counts and concurrency witnesses. RED pre-fix, GREEN post-fix, otherwise INCONCLUSIVE.

blocker.operation: bash -lc exact-repository checkout preflight before pytest
blocker.next_feasible_recovery: Use authorized disposable Linux checkout pinned to 378cffee64e9933b28ed9a40b936724db3beb09e, with source and test overlays only; run baseline and P0 writer/reader plus P1 process tests; retain exact-SHA logs. No repeat DNS clone.
